title: SEIZE OPPORTUNITIES
mv: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work or device or knowledge or wisdom in the grave where you are going.
mvp: “Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work or device or knowledge or wisdom in the grave where you are going.” Ecclesiastes 9:10 (NKJV)
assignment: Itemise five (5) opportunities God is drawing your attention to (2X5=10 marks).

b.x: Opportunities are openings, prospects, possibilities, etc., around us. To seize an opportunity is to get hold of a potential and use it to our advantage and as a means of blessing humanity. Opportunities abound everywhere, but only a few harness and effectively utilise them. Ironically, opportunities can be transient, and any door not quickly grabbed can be closed. It is time to swing into action and make use of open doors.
Opportunities abound all over the place, but we must use some means to access them. The following will help:

i: Network: Meet with people within and outside your field of interest, and do not be a loner (Ecclesiastes 4:9-10).

Be Smart: It takes a clever mind and sharp eyes to seize opportunities. Sometimes, prospects fly all around us, yet we do not see them because of short-sightedness or needless preoccupation with what is not (Proverbs 27:11a).
Maximise Open Doors: When doors open, utilise them before they close because it may be one door that is needed to move to the next phase (1 Corinthians 16:9a).
Learn: Loosen up to learn and never allow pride to hinder you from making use of opportunities (Proverbs 9:9).
Be On Top Of The Game: Get the necessary wherewithal to perform to the optimum when the opportunity arises to do so (Proverbs 22:29; Ecclesiastes 10:10).
Be Informed: Be informed because it is information that drives activities (Proverbs 18:15).
Lead: The ability to take the lead is a great trait for taking opportunities. Move beyond timidity and take a bold step to the fulfilment of your dreams and pursuits in life (Proverbs 28:1).
Be A Team Player: Be a good team player, work in the interest of others and always put in your best in every activity, as this creates opportunities (1 Corinthians 1:10, Philippians 2:3-4).
Shun Limitations: A good way to utilise opportunities is to turn restrictions into prospects (Romans 8:28; Genesis 50:19-20).

b.x: A lazy person will find it difficult to utilise opportunities because the person is always giving excuses and reasons that the task is impossible (Proverbs 22:13). A short-sighted individual with a closed mind to new ideas and who refuses to see far will not make use of opportunities (2 Kings 7:1-2). A nonchalant attitude or procrastination makes opportunities slip-bye especially when we think that the door will remain open forever (Ephesians 5:15-16; Proverbs 13:4). Complainers will not utilise opportunities because they only see impossibilities with the wall of restriction built around them (Ecclesiastes 11:4; Philippians 2:14). A strong focus on incapability, such as ‘I cannot do it,’ will veil us from seeing prospects.
Each day is an opportunity to be better; seize it.

i: Mention four ways to grab opportunities.
What are the hindrances to seizing opportunities?
